item.title: A Fruitless Conversation
item.description: Read A Fruitless Conversation Me: "What specific kind of fruit?" Customer: "Fruit!" Me: "Depending on the type, they're stored in different parts of the store." Customer: "Just fruit!" Read A Fruitless Conversation

item.title: The Grift That Keeps On Grifting
item.description: Read The Grift That Keeps On Grifting I used to serve at a well-known corporate Italian restaurant. We had some weekly regulars come in who would always make up fake issues so that our manager would comp their meal. I do not know why he would let them do this; there were always seven or eight of them who always made a huge scene and never tipped. Read The Grift That Keeps On Grifting
